speaker: FISHERS GUILD
text: The wind park has changed these fishing grounds considerably.

speaker: FISHERS GUILD
text: Our communities have depended on these waters for generations, both for our livelihoods and for local food supplies.

speaker: FISHERS GUILD
text: The underwater structures make bottom-trawling impossible in much of the area.

speaker: FISHERS GUILD
text: Unfortunately, most of our fishers do not have the equipment or training needed to switch to other fishing techniques.

speaker: FISHERS GUILD
text: The alternative fishing grounds are also much further from the coast, making them difficult and expensive to reach.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: The project therefore places pressure on the fishers' livelihoods, local employment and access to food.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: These impacts are particularly relevant to SDGs 1, 2 and 8.

speaker: FISHERS GUILD
text: We understand that Arcadia needs renewable energy, but we should not be expected to carry the cost of the transition alone.

speaker: FISHERS GUILD
text: We need a way to continue supporting our communities while the wind park remains in operation.
